title: All-h expected genuine D6 original sixset count
statement: For s=2^h (h>=1), with V=(s+1)(s^2+1), N=C(a,2)>=V minimal, independent uniform complete global injections f,g: E[D6]=M6(s)*60*((a)_6/(N)_6)^2 and E[D6]~(16/3)*s^6 as s->infinity. This is an ensemble expectation, not a worst-case bound.

quantifiers.domain: independent uniformly sampled complete original point and line global injections

external_dependencies: Actual original W(3,s) six-edge bipartite source matching count M6(s) and complete physical Hamiltonian C6 enumeration (see pinned proof).
limitations: The expectation does not imply inf_(f,g) D6 or S >= c*s^6.
Does not close Branch A, B or C and does not derive ASET R2/R3 exponents.
falsification_boundary: Check exact matching combinatorics and uniform full injection law; fixed maps may have D6=0.
